name: PeerTube
tagline: Federated open source video platform. YouTube alternative, no ads, no algorithm.
shortDescription: PeerTube is a federated, ActivityPub-based video hosting platform. Self-hostable, ad-free, no algorithm. Part of the Fediverse (like Mastodon for video).
longDescription:
## What it is

PeerTube is a self-hostable, federated video platform built on ActivityPub. Each instance (called a "PeerTube instance") hosts videos and can follow/be followed by other instances, creating a decentralized network. No ads, no algorithm, no tracking.

## Why we recommend it

If you want to host a video platform without YouTube's ads and algorithm, PeerTube is the answer. The federation means your instance is part of the broader Fediverse, so videos are discoverable across instances.

## When to use it

- Self-hosted video for creators who want no ads
- Niche communities hosting their own video library
- Federated video (part of the Fediverse)
- Educational, archival, or community video projects
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
```
git clone https://github.com/Chocobozzz/PeerTube
git checkout v6.x
cd PeerTube/support/docker/production
docker compose up -d
```

**Managed:** Some public instances allow you to create an account for free (framatube.org, peer.tube).
pricingDetails: Free. AGPL-3.0 licensed. Self-host on your own server.
